author: BornToDie
body: I was just playing on CTH01 and then i suddenly get banned for kill aura. I can say for the more than a year that i have been playing on avicus i have not used any form of a hacked client. I enjoy playing on this server very much and it is the only server i play now a days, so i wouldn't imagine risking that by using a hacked client. I hope that i get unbanned because i did not use any form of a hacked client so my ban should have never taken place. I hope you guys understand.
